<p style="text-align: justify;">
I’m Niklas, a quantitative researcher interested in making sense of complex societal questions through data. I work with a range of sources—including surveys, policy data, and population registers—to generate practical, evidence-informed insights.
</p>

*What I do:*

- **Quantitative Analysis & Modeling** – Longitudinal, spatial, and applied statistical approaches  
- **Evaluation & Monitoring** – Designing studies and indicators to understand impact  
- **Data Visualization** – Clear communication through reports and dashboards  
- **Interdisciplinary Work** – Background in public health, psychology, environment, and policy  

*You can explore my [projects](/projects.qmd), find more information in my [CV](/about.qmd), or read a [blog entry](/blog/blog.qmd).*
